note: Compiled from the same geometry model as cuts.csv and fixings.csv. Pilot entries marked STOP are mark-out only. Screw head seats are not modelled and require hardware confirmation.

operations.title: Receive and inspect B001
operations.detail: wickes-276785 | gross 2400 mm | reject twisted, split or unsound stock. Trims: start 0 mm, end 0 mm.

operations.title: Label B001 and mark datum A
operations.detail: Write board ID B001 on the timber and mark datum A. All cut coordinates run from this original A datum, even after squaring.

operations.title: Treat cut ends of B001
operations.detail: Apply the compatible cut-end preservative per the timber supplier's method before assembly.

operations.title: Place first-bed-01 course 1
operations.detail: Lay the course-1 members for first-bed-01 in the drawn positions (outside 2400 x 1400 mm).

operations.title: Clamp and check first-bed-01 course 1
operations.detail: Clamp the course, check square (equal outside diagonals) and level. Do not release the clamps until this course's fixings are driven.

operations.title: Mark out first-bed-01-C1-N-F01 - STOP before drilling
operations.detail: Pilot spec UNCONFIRMED: mark the centre only. Do NOT drill or drive until a recorded trial or manufacturer instruction confirms diameter and depth. horizontally into the OUTER outer face at U 50 / V 100 / W 50 mm from piece datum A (50, 1400, 50 global).

operations.title: Drive first-bed-01-C1-N-F01 (7 x 150 mm)
operations.detail: Drive wickes-287686 square to the entry face into receiver first-bed-01-C1-W. Nominal penetration 50 mm (includes the point; not rated embedment). Head seat: confirm against the actual hardware - heads and recesses are NOT modelled.
